```artifact
GUI Event Graphs Test Suite for U18_GUI, RW-SW-96, RW-SW-99, RW-SW-139, RW-SW-141, RW-SW-155

Following the GUI Event Graphs notation, each test case is represented as a node in the graph, with edges representing the flow from one test case to the next.

Test Case 1: Display FiO2 Measurement
- Start at the main screen
- Navigate to the FiO2 measurement screen
- Verify that FiO2 is displayed correctly

Test Case 2: Set PIP Range
- Start at the main screen
- Navigate to the PIP setting screen
- Verify that PIP can be set from 5 to 55 cmH2O
- Verify that increments are 1 cm H2O

Test Case 3: Detect Controller Shutdown
- Start at the main screen
- Navigate to the controller status screen
- Verify that controller shutdown is detected

Test Case 4: Rise Time Parameter
- Start at the main screen
- Navigate to the rise time parameter screen
- Verify that rise time can be set from 0 to 20% of breath cycle time

Test Case 5: Assist/Control Mode Setting
- Start at the main screen
- Navigate to the assist/control mode setting screen
- Verify that assist/control mode can be set correctly

This test suite covers all the functional requirements specified in the given set. Each test case is represented as a node in the GUI Event Graphs, with edges representing the flow from one test case to the next. The JSON list contains the same test cases as the artifact, one object per test case, with ids TC-001, TC-002, ...
